homes.title: Change home
museum.curator.hello:
Hoo! Welcome to the museum!
Do take your time with the exhibits.
museum.curator.0:
We now have {fish} kinds of fish
and {bugs} kinds of bugs on display! Hoo!
museum.curator.1:
The fish in their tanks…
I could watch them for hours.
museum.curator.2:
The insect wing… I confess, bugs make
my feathers stand on end… Brrr.
museum.curator.3:
Whenever you find a new creature,
it goes on display here at once!
museum.curator.4:
I'm a night owl, you know.
The evening is when I'm most awake. Hoo!
museum.curator.5:
Sell your catch if you like! What's in
the Critterpedia stays on display here.
museum.curator.6:
We have {fossils} fossils on display!
Every bone is a treasure, I say.
museum.curator.7:
Our gallery holds {art} works of art.
Every one of them genuine! Hoo!
museum.curator.8:
Do peek into the sea creatures’
tanks before you go!
museum.curator.9:
Once every bone is in, the skeleton
stands complete. Magnificent!
museum.curator.10:
I hear balloons now and then carry
a fine painting… Hoo, how curious.
museum.curator.new:
Hoo! The {name} has just arrived!
Do go and have a look.
